pages.text: In order to obtain The Cursed Eye, you must defeat Echo of Tyros, it is known for high-damage spells, a multi-phase fight full of flame and summons.
The ancient map that leads you to the Citadel, an ancient monument in the Nether belonging to a time long past.
Cinderous Soulcaller can be used on Cinderous Soul Rune, located in the center of the arena, to summon the boss.
